name: jev-api
description: Lets Claude put yes/no, choice and score questions about a text to TypeSafe's Jev System One in one request.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: HTTP timeout of one System One request in seconds, at most 30, used when a tool call gives no valid timeout of its own (invalid or unset: 20).

overflow.title: Overflow
overflow.description: What a call does when its state and questions are too large for System One or for the timeout, used when the call names no valid overflow of its own: error (refuse with the numbers), truncate (cut the middle of the state) or haiku (answer with Claude Haiku). Invalid or unset: haiku.
